Loading all libraries required

```{r}
library(terra)
library(predicts)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)

myPalette2 <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")),space="Lab")
```

## Training the models and predicting
```{r message=FALSE}
# Predictor variables
e <- ext(-179, 179, -59, 83) #left, right, bottom, top
biosoil<-rast("C:/Users/plexaaron/UFL Dropbox/Aaron Plex Sula/168/2022/2022 Projects/Pathogen biogeography/Model validation/biosoilvar.tif")
biosoil<-biosoil[[1:10]]

# Geographic coordinates of occurrences
geo.presence <- read.csv("C:/Users/plexaaron/UFL Dropbox/Aaron Plex Sula/168/2022/2022 Projects/Pathogen biogeography/Model validation/Ralstonia solanacearum/Ralstonia_Global_Diversity_Current_7_29.csv")
## Focusing the analysis on sequevar 1 (Ralstonia solanacearum race 3 biovar 2)
geo.presence<-geo.presence[geo.presence$Sequevar == "1",]
## Focusing the analysis on sub-national occurrences and unique geographic coordinates
countries <- unique(geo.presence$Location..Country.or.Territory.)
geo.presence<-geo.presence[!geo.presence$Location.Isolated %in% countries,]
geo.presence<-geo.presence[,c("Longitude","Latitude")]
geo.presence <- geo.presence[!duplicated(geo.presence[, c("Longitude", "Latitude")]), ]

colnames(geo.presence)<-c("x","y")
vectorPresence<-vect(geo.presence, 
                 crs="+proj=longlat", geom=c("x","y"))
vectorPresence<-crop(vectorPresence, e)
training.bios<-terra::extract(biosoil, vectorPresence)
training.bios<-cbind(geo.presence, training.bios[,-1])
#training.bio <- training.bio[which(is.na(training.bio$) != TRUE),]
training.bios$pb<-1

#Generating background points as pseudo-absence
biosoil<-aggregate(biosoil, fact = 20, fun = mean, na.rm=TRUE)
cells <- terra::extract(biosoil, vectorPresence, cells = T)$cell
mask <- biosoil[[1]] * 0
mask[cells] <- NA
background <- terra::as.data.frame(mask, xy = T)
background <- dplyr::sample_n(background, size = dim(vectorPresence)[1]*5, replace = FALSE)
vecBackground <- vect(background[,c(1,2)], 
                 crs="+proj=longlat", geom=c("y","x"))
background <- cbind(background[,c(1,2)], extract(biosoil, vecBackground)[,-1])
background <- background[which(is.na(background$AM_Temperature)==FALSE),]
background <- background[which(is.na(background$`sand_15-30cm`)==FALSE),]
background$pb <- 0

training.data <- rbind(training.bios, background)
sum(is.na(training.data))
training.data <- training.data[which(is.na(training.data$`soc_15-30cm`)==FALSE),]
#training.data <- training.data[which(is.na(training.data$travel_time_to_ports_1)==FALSE),]
sum(is.na(training.data))

training.data<-training.data[,-1]
training.data<-training.data[,-1]
colnames(training.data)<-c("AM_Temperature","MDiurnal_Range", "Isothermality",
                           "Annual_precipitation","Precipitation_seasonality",
                           "sand","ph","clay","silt","soc","pb")

# A dataset for predictions
AM_Temperature<-as.vector(values(biosoil$AM_Temperature))
MDiurnal_Range<-as.vector(values(biosoil$MDiurnal_Range))
Isothermality<-as.vector(values(biosoil$Isothermality))
Annual_precipitation<-as.vector(values(biosoil$Annual_precipitation))
Precipitation_seasonality<-as.vector(values(biosoil$Precipitation_seasonality))
sand<-as.vector(values(biosoil$`sand_15-30cm`))
ph<-as.vector(values(biosoil$`phh2o_15-30cm`))
clay<-as.vector(values(biosoil$`clay_15-30cm`))
silt<-as.vector(values(biosoil$`silt_15-30cm`))
soc<-as.vector(values(biosoil$`soc_15-30cm`))

new.data<-cbind(AM_Temperature, MDiurnal_Range, Isothermality, Annual_precipitation,
                Precipitation_seasonality,sand, ph, clay, silt, soc)
new.data<-as.data.frame(new.data)
colnames(new.data)<-c("AM_Temperature","MDiurnal_Range", "Isothermality",
                           "Annual_precipitation","Precipitation_seasonality",
                           "sand","ph","clay","silt","soc")
non.missing<-which(is.na(rowSums(new.data))==FALSE)
```


# Training the random forest model
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#Training the random forest model
library(mlr) ##UPDATE TO mlr3
pathoTask<-makeRegrTask(data = training.data, target = "pb")
kFold<-makeResampleDesc("CV", iters = 10)
forest<-makeLearner("regr.randomForest")
forestParamSpace<-makeParamSet(
  makeIntegerParam("ntree", lower = 100, upper = 100), #trees in the forest > better
  makeIntegerParam("mtry", lower = 2, upper = 10), #features to randomly sample at each node
  makeIntegerParam("nodesize", lower = 5, upper = 100), #minimum cases in a leaf (think about the # occurrences in the dataset)
  makeIntegerParam("maxnodes", lower = 5, upper = 30) #maximum leaves allowed (fewer nodes means more strict)
)

randSearch<-makeTuneControlRandom(maxit = 1000)

tunedForestPars <- tuneParams(forest, task = pathoTask,
                              resampling = kFold,
                              par.set = forestParamSpace,
                              control = randSearch)
tunedForestPars

tunedForest <- setHyperPars(forest, par.vals = tunedForestPars$x)
tunedForestModel <- train(tunedForest, pathoTask)
forestModelData <- getLearnerModel(tunedForestModel)
plot(forestModelData)

#outer cross-validation to evaluate how well the model performs
#outCV <- makeResampleDesc("CV", iters = 5)
#forestWrapper <- makeTuneWrapper("regr.randomForest",
#                                 resampling = kFold,
#                                 par.set = forestParamSpace,
#                                 control = randSearch)
#cvWithTuning <- resample(forestWrapper, roreriTask, resampling = outCV)
#cvWithTuning

# Predictions based on the trained random forest model
predictions<-predict(tunedForestModel, newdata = new.data[non.missing,])
predictions<-predictions$data$response
predictions<-ifelse(predictions>0, predictions, 0)
new.data$pred<-NaN
new.data$pred[non.missing]<-predictions
hist(predictions)
sum(predictions>0)
sum(predictions>0)/length(predictions)
```


# Potential geographic distribution informed by a random forest
```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=10, message=FALSE}
predicted.distribution<-biosoil$AM_Temperature
values(predicted.distribution)<-new.data$pred
names(predicted.distribution)<-"predictedRSIIBRandomForest"

map_grey_background <- rast("C:/Users/plexaaron/UFL Dropbox/Aaron Plex Sula/168/2022/2022 Projects/Pathogen biogeography/Predictor variables/map_grey_background.tif")
map_grey_background <- project(map_grey_background,
                               "+proj=robin +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")
predicted.distribution<-project(predicted.distribution, "+proj=robin +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")

plot(map_grey_background, col = "grey75",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, main = "Predicted distribution based on random forest")
plot(predicted.distribution, col=myPalette2(100), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE))
```


# Training the XGBoost model
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
xgb <- makeLearner("regr.xgboost")
xgbParamSpace <- makeParamSet(
  makeNumericParam("eta", lower = 0, upper = 1), #learning rate
  makeNumericParam("gamma", lower = 0, upper = 10), # minimum amount of splitting by which a node must improve the predictions
  makeIntegerParam("max_depth", lower = 1, upper = 20), #maximum depth of trees
  makeNumericParam("min_child_weight", lower = 1, upper = 10), #degree of impurity
  makeNumericParam("subsample", lower = 0, upper = 1), #proportion of sampling cases or occurrences
  makeNumericParam("colsample_bytree", lower = 0.2, upper = 1), #proportion of predictor variables sampled for each tree
  makeIntegerParam("nrounds", lower = 50, upper = 50) #the number of sequentially built trees in the model
)
tunedXgbPars <- tuneParams(xgb, task = pathoTask,
                           resampling = kFold,
                           par.set = xgbParamSpace,
                           control = randSearch)
tunedXgbPars

tunedXgb <- setHyperPars(xgb, par.vals = tunedXgbPars$x)
tunedXgbModel <- train(tunedXgb, pathoTask)
xgbModelData <- getLearnerModel(tunedXgbModel)

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data = xgbModelData$evaluation_log, aes(xgbModelData$evaluation_log$iter, xgbModelData$evaluation_log$train_rmse))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(x="Iterations", y="Train rmse")
```

# Projected potential geographic distribution informed by gradient boosting (XGboost)
```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=10, warning=FALSE}
xgbpredictions<-predict(tunedXgbModel, newdata = new.data[non.missing,1:10])
xgbpredictions<-xgbpredictions$data$response
new.data$xgbpred<-NaN
new.data$xgbpred[non.missing]<-xgbpredictions
hist(xgbpredictions)
sum(xgbpredictions>0)
sum(xgbpredictions>0)/length(predictions)

xgbpredicted.distribution<-biosoil$AM_Temperature
values(xgbpredicted.distribution)<-new.data$xgbpred
names(xgbpredicted.distribution)<-"predictedRSIIBXGBoost"
xgbpredicted.distribution<-project(xgbpredicted.distribution, "+proj=robin +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")

plot(map_grey_background, col = "grey75",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, main = "Predicted distribution based on XGBoost")
plot(xgbpredicted.distribution, col=myPalette2(100), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE))
```



# Training the logistic regression model
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
training.data$pb<-as.factor(training.data$pb)
pathoTasklog<-makeClassifTask(data = training.data, target = "pb")
logReg<-makeLearner("classif.logreg", predict.type = "prob")
logRegModel<-train(logReg, pathoTasklog)

logRegWrapper <- makeImputeWrapper("classif.logreg",
                                   cols = list(sand = imputeMean()))
kFold <- makeResampleDesc(method = "RepCV", folds = 10, reps = 200, 
                          stratify = TRUE)
logRegwithImpute <- resample(logRegWrapper, pathoTasklog,
                             resampling = kFold,
                             measures = list(acc, fpr, fnr))
logRegwithImpute
logRegModelData<-getLearnerModel(logRegModel)
coef(logRegModelData)

#calculating odds ratios
exp(cbind(Odds_Ration = coef(logRegModelData), confint(logRegModelData)))
```


# Projecting geographic distribution based on logistic regression
```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=10, warning=FALSE}
logPredictions <- predict(logRegModel, newdata = new.data[non.missing,])
logPredictions<-logPredictions$data$prob.1
new.data$logpred<-NaN
new.data$logpred[non.missing]<-logPredictions

logpredicted.distribution<-biosoil$AM_Temperature
values(logpredicted.distribution)<-new.data$logpred
names(logpredicted.distribution)<-"predictedRSIIBLogistic"
logpredicted.distribution<-project(logpredicted.distribution, "+proj=robin +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")

plot(map_grey_background, col = "grey75",  xaxt='n',  yaxt='n', axes=F, box=F, legend = F, main = "Predicted distribution based on logistic regression")
plot(logpredicted.distribution, col=myPalette2(100), xaxt = 'n', yaxt = 'n', axes = F, box = F, add = T, legend = T, plg = list(loc = "bottom", horizontal = TRUE))
```


Saving outcomes in raster format
```{r}
geopredictions<-list(predicted.distribution, xgbpredicted.distribution, logpredicted.distribution)
geopredictions<-rast(geopredictions)
names(geopredictions)<-c("RSIIB1RandomForest","RSIIB1XGBoost","RSIIB1Logistic")
writeRaster(geopredictions, "RSIIB1Projections.tif", overwrite=TRUE)
```
